Description:
Enhance your mineral collection with this striking lot featuring three unique mineral specimens. Included is a vivid blue piece likely to be lapis lazuli, known for its deep ultramarine color and speckled texture. Also present is a white matrix rock embedded with brilliant blue minerals, offering an eye-catching contrast and crystalline sparkle. Completing the set is a quartz-like stone hosting embedded black crystals, possibly black tourmaline, with defined geometric structure and a dramatic natural look. Each mineral specimen has distinctive features, making this lot a great choice for collectors, educational displays, or enthusiasts of natural earth treasures. These unpolished pieces highlight raw geological beauty, suitable for display in any setting. All items are presented in good condition, with naturally occurring textures and occasional minor marks due to their unrefined state. Add these unique and visually striking minerals to your collection for a touch of natural history

282451786.description:
Natural mineral specimen featuring a polished triangular slab of Manganese Firestone with reddish-brown oval and elongated patterns on a gray matrix. The slab is mounted on a grooved base of striped Zebra Rock showing banded brown, cream, and dark gray layers. A hand-written label on the base states '600 million yrs old, ZEBRA ROCK & MANGANESE FIRESTONE, Kununurra, Kimberley, Australia,' indicating its geological origin. The specimen combines natural rough edges on the firestone piece with polished faces and base. This collectible rock/mineral specimen is in used/display condition and is suitable as a decorative paperweight, bookend, or geology collector's item. No manufacturer brand present.
